title: Benchmark of Pauli Correlation Encoding for different optimisation problems
summary: The continuous progress of quantum technologies has spurred the exploration of their potential applications across diverse fields, particularly in combinatorial optimisation. In this work, we study a quantum-classical optimisation framework based on Pauli Correlation Encoding, an encoding scheme that can represent m binary variables using a polynomial number of qubits. To evaluate the performance of the method, we use three classical optimisation problems against the instances of the QOPTLib benchmark.
